summary: Phases 1-5 of the six-phase plan are implemented and verified green: the development marker is registered in code/pyproject.toml (with the deliberate oracle/conftest.py non-mirroring note); all six gating -m invocations across tests.yml, differential-tests.yml, flake.nix, and run-oracle-suite.sh carry 'and not development'; code/tests/ci/test_unstable_deselection_wiring.py was extended in place to enforce both markers (bite-confirmed by a temporary-revert check); unstable_watch_classify.py gained a third, optional dev_junit_path input producing DEV_STATUS-classified records that never feed any_new/any_failure and are excluded from the currently_unstable fragment-matching loop; fetch_past_classifications was generalized with a defaulted field selector and compute_dev_pass_rate feeds a new '## Development Watch' step-summary section; TESTING_GUIDE.md section 8.14 documents the whole category plus one appended sentence in 8.9. code/tests/ci/ is fully green (83 tests) and collection-level equivalence of the new filter is proven by an exact empty diff of --collect-only output (3055 lines each, with vs without 'and not development') -- definitive proof the filter deselects nothing today. Phase 6 (full-gate verification) is PARTIAL, not COMPLETED: the full gating execution command (pytest ... -n 4 with the new filter) was run twice under a 580s timeout bound and exited 124 both times (killed, not a clean pass), showing 4 F's and an xdist worker crash ('[gw0] node down: Not properly terminated', 'replacing crashed worker gw0') near 93-96% collected on the first attempt. A targeted rerun scoped to the two implicated bimodal files (test_frame_constraints.py, test_frame_class_mapping.py) was itself confounded: task 153 is concurrently mid-flight on those exact files plus uncommitted changes to bimodal/semantic/core.py in the shared working tree, and had already landed commit b7bc19c3 (four intentionally-red test classes) during this task's own Phase 6 window. No failure attributable to this task's own scope was observed or is plausible given the collection-equivalence proof; the worker-crash excerpt is recorded as evidence for task 174 (root_cause_xdist_worker_crash, not_started) rather than investigated here. The one-file file_scope widening (unstable_watch_classify.py), the deferred unstable-watch.yml third-step /spawn candidate, the flagged-not-done release.yml comment update, and the deliberate oracle/conftest.py non-mirroring are all recorded in the implementation summary as required.
